launchd_escape.before.source.reason: Relay before the single-start guard: `launchctl submit` restarts the job after every exit, so a command longer than launchd's 10 s throttle started again as soon as it ended, truncating its out/err before the relay read them (integration run 2026-11-16: test_agent_ci_shards CiGateTests lost its unittest summary, rc 0) and rerunning it until the label was removed.

launchd_escape.bf8d2da2.before.source.reason: Unfixed integrate-speed launchd escape at bf8d2da2 (review-speed findings 4-8): the `launchctl submit` relay gave the job launchd's soft nofile 256 and launchd's SSH_AUTH_SOCK/XPC_* (relay-only test_tmux_public_intent_race failures), left a restarting job after a relay SIGKILL, waited for a lost exit status until the outer timeout, could run the command both as the job and directly after a failed submit, and `_run` escaped every command bounded at 30 minutes or more (run_checks, scripts/visual_review.py, the SSH keeper child).
